milestones.label: Application deadline (Cambridge Trust awards: the course's funding deadline in the University of Cambridge Course Directory)
milestones.source_text: The Cambridge Trust (official) says the deadline is the funding deadline shown on each course page in the Course Directory. The two dates for the 2027 cycle, 8 December 2026 and 6 January 2027, are the ones Gates Cambridge (official) publishes for those same Cambridge course funding deadlines and that scholarship sites report for Cambridge Trust awards.

milestones.label: Cambridge Trust funding decisions
milestones.source_text: The Cambridge Trust (official) says most awards are made in February and March, partner-funded awards often between April and June, and that no news by the end of July means the application was unsuccessful.
